name: Ribeye with Spicy "Cowboy" Butter, Butternut Squash & Brussels Sprouts
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and peel squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and medium dice. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Trim and halve Brussels sprouts lengthwise. Add to the baking sheet with the squash.
Zest lemon into a small bowl (set aside for later use). Juice lemon over the veggies, then season with salt and pepper; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Cut butter into small pieces and sprinkle over the veggies.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until the veggies are fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the pan is hot, coat with butter. Add steak and grill until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
While the steak is cooking, peel and mince shallot and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the lemon zest.
Cut additional butter into small pieces and add to the bowl along with Dijon and spices. Mash with the back of a spoon to combine the "cowboy" butter.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and veggies between plates. Top steak with cowboy butter and enjoy!
author: Mealime
